map.30 人中 12 人低于 80、3 人等于 80：PR=(12+0.5×3)/3: Among 30 people, 12 score below 80 and 3 equal 80: PR=(12+0.5×3)/30×100=(13.5)/30×100=45, i.e. ahead of roughly 45% of the group (the 45th percentile).
map.百分位 P_k 是\"第 k% 的人低于此值\"的分数；百分等级是某分数对应的: The percentile P_k is the score below which k% of people fall; the percentile rank is the k matching a given score, so the two are inverse functions.
map.把等于自身的半个人计入排名，避免把自身算作\"低于\"，是常用经验修正。: It counts half of the tied cases, avoiding treating one's own score as below itself; a standard empirical correction.
map.百分等级（本页代码口径）：PR=(小于目标值的个数+0.5×等于目标值的个数)÷: Percentile rank (as coded on this page): PR=(count of values below the target + 0.5×count of values equal to the target)÷N×100 (%, N=total number of data points; data are parsed item by item with parseFloat after comma splitting); related values: no other derived items. Validation: after parseFloat, non-finite items are filtered out (unparseable items are not counted in N); a non-numeric target defaults to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; PR represents the relative position of the target in the sample, and exactly 50 means the sample median level.
